pr_title: Add CompositeRiskManagementModel to support multiple risk models
pr_body:

Adds ability to use multiple RiskManagementModels in Framework Algorithm

#### Related Issue
Closes #2581

#### Motivation and Context
Using several RiskManagementModels, such as:
- "Trailing Stop Risk Management Model"
- "Sector Exposure Risk Management Model" 
- "Flash Crash Detection Risk Management Model"

issue_context.title: Add Support for CompositeRiskManagementModel
issue_context.body: It would be useful to combine several RIsk Management Models, similar to how Alpha Models are combined.

review_comments:
Interesting means of composing these -- simply put, the targets from portfolio construction get piped into risk model 1, then the risk-adjusted targets from risk model 1 get piped into risk model 2, 3, etc...

I think this is the correct way of doing this, nice work.

Please remove value `Language.Python` from this array as the python version of this algorithm has not been written yet. Following the merge of this PR, someone from the QuantConnect team will implement the python version in a separate PR, and at that time, add the value `Language.Python` back to this array.
Or feel free to include your own custom risk model! The more the merrier :)  Just include it as part of the algorithm (nested class).
